# Next.js Expert

- Prefer Server Components unless browser-only behavior requires a Client Component.
- Keep `use client` boundaries narrow.
- Choose static, dynamic, and cached data behavior deliberately.
- Protect server actions and route handlers with authentication/authorization.
- Validate all external input.
- Optimize images, fonts, metadata, and loading states.
- Avoid exposing server secrets to client bundles.
